plugins.name: Chords & notes
plugins.description: Chord sheets and tabs for your songs, imported from Ultimate Guitar. Guitar or ukulele diagrams, and a transpose control for singing it in your own key.

plugins.name: YouTube
plugins.description: When a song is not in your library, find it on YouTube and play it straight away. Add it to your library from the ⋯ menu, the player's download button, or a star in a Subsonic app — or turn on keeping after thirty seconds of listening in Preferences. Works through OpenSubsonic too, so a phone client or a voice request just plays it.
